Class SecureSerialServerSocket

java.lang.Object
com.sgware.serialsoc.SerialServerSocket
com.sgware.serialsoc.SimpleSerialServerSocket
com.sgware.serialsoc.SecureSerialServerSocket
All Implemented Interfaces:
CheckedRunnable, AutoCloseable, Callable<Void>
public class SecureSerialServerSocket extends SimpleSerialServerSocket
A SimpleSerialServerSocket that uses an SSLServerSocket to accept encrypted SSLSockets, reads and writes to those sockets using text, and separates incoming and outgoing messages with new line characters.
Author:
Stephen G. Ware

  • Method Details

    • accept

      protected SSLSocket accept() throws IOException
      Description copied from class: SerialServerSocket
      Blocks until a new socket connects to the server and then returns it. This method does not run on the same thread that called SerialServerSocket.run(). Once this method returns a socket, it does not run again until after SerialServerSocket.create(Socket) and SerialServerSocket.onAccept(SerialSocket) have finished processing the socket. If this method throws an exception, the server closes.
      Overrides:
      accept in class SimpleSerialServerSocket
      Returns:
      a newly accepted socket
      Throws:
      IOException
